$comment: The series narration voice. 'provider' picks the engine; its settings are under its own name. Chatterbox (the series voice since the introduction's second cut) is cloned from voice/reference.wav, 12 s of the first voice, Kokoro's Emma, reading the introduction's opening, so it keeps her timbre and accent while reading with the stress and intonation Kokoro cannot give. It runs locally with no account or key (voice/requirements.txt, tools/voice_worker.py), with its model pinned to one revision, and each clip is heard back by local speech recognisers and made again with the next seed when it does not match the script (tools/lib/verify.js), and inspected for sounds that are not speech: a squeal after the last word is cut off, and one inside the speech fails the clip (tools/voice_worker.py, inspect). The timing settings lay the cues out (tools/lib/narration.js): silence before the first cue, between cues in a scene, and between scenes; and how long before its first cue a scene's pictures arrive. See series.md, 'Voice'.
